description: Defines a data transfer object (DTO) named VehicleResponse used for representing vehicle information in API responses. It includes properties like id, vin, licensePlate, make, model, year, and status, along with constructors, getters, and setters.

classes.name: VehicleResponse
classes.description: A DTO class for vehicle data returned by the API, annotated with Swagger schema annotations for API documentation.
